recruiter.title: Recruiter
recruiter.description: A recruiter user who can manage job postings and view candidate reports.

uid.description: The unique ID of the recruiter (Firebase Auth UID).

email.description: The email address of the recruiter.

companyName.description: The name of the recruiter's company.

companyWebsite.description: The website of the recruiter's company.

companySize.description: The size range of the company (e.g., 1-10, 11-50).

status.description: The verification status of the recruiter.
